name: cupsd.conf Allow/Deny IPv6 needs brackets
description: In cupsd.conf, an IPv6 literal in Allow/Deny must be bracketed (Allow [fe80::]/10, Allow [fd00::]/8); without brackets conf.c parse_aaa routes the token to the hostname/domain branch (cupsdAddNameMask), so e.g. 'Allow fe80::/10' silently never matches anyone. @LOCAL is valid and expands to the server's own interface subnets (v4+v6, non-point-to-point). Verified in OpenPrinting/cups v2.4.19 scheduler/conf.c parse_aaa + auth.c cupsdAddNameMask, and man cupsd.conf Allow grammar.

name: CUPS cupsd.conf: top-level Limit ignored; use Policy
description: In modern CUPS (>=2.4, Alpine ships 2.4.19), a top-level <Limit op...> outside <Location>/<Policy> hits 'Unknown directive' in the config parser and is ignored (read_policy/read_location only accept Limit in those two contexts; Location Limits take HTTP methods only, Policy Limits take IPP op names incl 'All'). To override op authorization (e.g. Cancel-Job for anonymous LAN users) you must define <Policy default> and list ops in <Limit> blocks there; ops not listed in any Limit are allowed by cupsdCheckPolicy (no match => OK), while listed ops are matched exact-first then wildcard. Also: cupsd itself mkdirs StateDir (default /var/run/cups = /run/cups on Alpine) + certs subdir at startup when run as root, and 'Port 631' binds IPv4+IPv6 (get_address -> httpAddrGetList(NULL, AF_UNSPEC)), while 'Listen 0.0.0.0:631' is v4-only.

name: AirPrint stack on Alpine CUPS add-ons
description: For AirPrint/DNS-SD from an Alpine CUPS (add-on) container: Alpine's cups APKBUILD builds with avahi-dev+dbus-dev, so cupsd's shared-printer advertisement (Browsing Yes + BrowseLocalProtocols dnssd) registers _ipp._tcp services through libavahi-client, which talks to avahi-daemon over the D-Bus system bus (org.freedesktop.Avahi) - so both dbus and avahi must run before cupsd, and avahi-daemon.conf needs enable-dbus=yes. cupsd dirsvc.c publishes URF TXT records so Apple devices treat queues as AirPrint. dbus-daemon --system forks by default because /usr/share/dbus-1/system.conf contains <fork/>. Alpine avahi package runs daemon as avahi user; --no-drop-root avoids that. mDNS is UDP 5353 multicast - no TCP/UDP port mapping can help it; with HA host_network:true the container already shares the host stack.
